title: Cars Are A Disaster For Society -- Here Are the Numbers
summary: CityNerd's Ray Delahanty tallies the personal costs of driving and then the externalities that car dependency imposes on everyone else, with numbers for each. It is an urbanist case that driving is heavily subsidized and costs society far more than drivers pay.
why: HN commenters cite it as the video version of the research on the social cost of driving when arguing cars impose uncompensated costs on others.

quote.text: each mile you drive in your car incurs costs on the rest of society that nobody directly pays
